overall_assessment: The rollback procedures, promotion authority, and public-package bounds codified across integration/release-train.json, release/public-packages.json, and docs/release-train.md embody the highest standards of safety, reversibility, and fail-closed governance. The rollback contract specifies four non-negotiable operational steps: 1) restore the prior exact revision in the affected integration passport; 2) disable the adapter feature or compatibility path; 3) re-run consumer fixtures and preserve the failed receipt; and 4) do not delete prior schemas, fixtures, tags, or migration evidence. This directly prevents catastrophic evidence destruction and ensures auditable forensic tracking during regressions. Promotion authority is strictly human-gated: automatic promotion is barred across the release train and all six stages, while automated jobs (.github/workflows/integration-release-train.yml and scripts/check_integration_drift.py) are strictly read-only and prohibited from altering pins, merging code, or updating public claims. Furthermore, public package policy in release/public-packages.json enforces deny_unlisted_and_require_compiler_semver_supply_chain_evidence: all three candidate public packages (evidence-search-contracts, evidence-search-core, searchright-plugin-sdk) are locked to publication_status: blocked and publish_ready: false, each bound to explicit compiler, MSRV, SemVer, cargo-vet, and consumer contract checklists. Deterministic checks scripts/check_release_train.py and scripts/check_public_package_policy.py verify that publication cannot proceed without explicit compiler and human release evidence.
verified_invariants: explicit four-step rollback procedure: restore prior exact revision in passport, disable adapter feature flag, re-run fixtures, preserve failure receipt
strict evidence preservation mandate: absolute prohibition against deleting prior schemas, fixtures, tags, or migration evidence during rollback
fail-closed public package policy: all workspace packages default to non-publishable; candidate packages blocked pending compiler, SemVer, and supply-chain evidence
uncompromised human promotion authority: release train, ecosystem lock, and promotion stage reject automated promotion and require explicit human sign-off
read-only surveillance boundaries: integration drift surveillance checks compare pins and emit read-only receipts without mutating source pins or remote repositories
automated policy enforcement: scripts/check_release_train.py, scripts/check_public_package_policy.py, and tests/test_cross_repository_release_train_governance.py pass 100% network-free

findings.description: Rollback steps and human promotion authorities are formally specified and test-verified; exercising rollback during an active release-candidate rehearsal and recording a human promotion receipt remain open operational gates.
findings.recommendation: Preserve open gate T32-G-PROMOTION-APPROVAL until rollback is rehearsed and explicit human promotion approval is documented.

findings.description: Public package policy in release/public-packages.json strictly enforces MSRV 1.88 for the shared layer and requires cargo semver-checks and cargo-vet audits prior to any promotion.
findings.recommendation: Retain check_public_package_policy.py as a required gate in CI pull request validation.

assertions_evaluated.notes: Rollback procedures, human promotion authority, and default-deny public package bounds verified in source contracts and governance tests.
Promotion order and passport rollback linkage ensure changes can be cleanly unwound to prior exact pinned revisions.

limitations: Source-verified rollback contract and publication policy only; operational execution of release-candidate rehearsals and human promotion approval remain open gates.
